**TL;DR:** High-momentum technology hardware and heavy industrials continue to dominate market strength, while a sharp rotation is punishing precious metals and defensive sectors.

Technology hardware and heavy machinery remain entrenched at the absolute top of the market. Electronic Components (0.941 momentum) and Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.935 momentum) lead the charge alongside Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (0.931 momentum), all maintaining "all-green" status across all timeframes. Simultaneously, a powerful rotation is underway into growth and cyclical areas, with Biotechnology jumping 22 spots to rank 67 and Residential Construction climbing 21 spots to rank 63.

Conversely, defensive and commodity-linked sectors are fading rapidly. Precious metals are experiencing a severe sell-off, led by Silver diving 57 spots to rank 86 and Gold plunging 40 spots to rank 120. Aerospace & Defense (-35 spots) and Coking Coal (-25 spots) are also losing ground rapidly. Additionally, some high-momentum areas like Steel and Trucking are showing early signs of fading as their ranks slip despite high momentum.

## Strength
* **Healthy Breadth:** 29 of 144 industry groups maintain "all-green" status, indicating positive performance across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD timeframes.
* **Tech & Industrial Leadership:** Electronic Components (0.94) and Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.93) lead the all-green cohort, supported by sustained strength in Semiconductor Equipment & Materials.
* **Heavy Cyclicals:** Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (0.93) and Metal Fabrication (0.90) show robust, multi-month leadership as sustained strong performers.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Biotechnology surged 22 spots to rank 67 (momentum 0.74), followed closely by Residential Construction, which rose 21 spots to rank 63 (momentum 0.73), and Airlines, up 20 spots to rank 53 (momentum 0.83).
* **Precious Metals Collapse:** Silver fell 57 spots to rank 86 (momentum 0.32), Gold dropped 40 spots to rank 120 (momentum 0.21), and Other Precious Metals & Mining slid 31 spots to rank 133 (momentum 0.19).
* **Momentum Laggards:** Secular weakness persists at the bottom of the rankings, led by Pharmaceutical Retailers (momentum 0.023, rank 144) and Software - Application (momentum 0.106, rank 142).

## Divergences
* **Fading Leaders:** Steel (momentum 0.66) and Capital Markets (momentum 0.67) are showing early fatigue, dropping 8 and 5 spots respectively over the last 5 sessions. Even top-ranked Electronics & Computer Distribution slipped 1 spot.
* **Emerging Bottom-Fishers:** Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+13 spots, momentum 0.48) and Health Information Services (+11 spots, momentum 0.45) are climbing the ranks despite lagging momentum scores.
* **Fragile All-Green:** Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances is flagged as unstable despite its green status, showing a low agreement score of 0.50.
